title: Dual contract — the shape of every LLM-derived value
description: Every response from `ai_enrich` (or any other LLM hop) MUST validate against this before it is allowed near an artifact. `ai_enrich`'s `output_schema` is specified as 'used to guide structured output' — guidance, not enforcement — so the runtime validates the response itself. A response that fails is written `ai_inferred_invalid` and NEVER lands in an artifact as verified. A response that passes is marked `ai_inferred` and is never mixed into verified fields. This replaces the four conflicting null conventions found across 175 analyzed custom-research prompts with exactly ONE explicit null enum.

result.description: The answer, or ONE of the three explicit nulls. There is no other way to say 'no answer': not JSON null, not "", not "N/A", not "unknown", not [] and not {}.

oneOf.title: explicit null
oneOf.description: not_found = looked, nothing there. not_verifiable = something there, cannot be confirmed from the given source. not_applicable = the question does not apply to this row.

oneOf.title: a real value
oneOf.description: Any real value. Empty string, empty array, empty object and the alias strings below are rejected — an empty answer must use the explicit null enum instead.

confidence.description: Numeric 0..1 only. "high"/"medium"/"low" is one of the conflicting conventions this contract removes.

reasoning.description: Why the model answered this way. Required even for the explicit nulls — a null with no reasoning is indistinguishable from a failed call.

source.description: What the answer was derived from: a URL, an endpoint name, or `model_prior` when the model used nothing but itself. `model_prior` is still `ai_inferred`, never verified.

provenance.description: Optional in the response; always stamped by the runtime on store. LLM-derived values are ALWAYS marked ai_inferred and are NEVER mixed into verified fields.

x-storage.valid: artifact.ai_inferred[<field>] — marked provenance:'ai_inferred', never merged into artifact.verified
x-storage.invalid: artifact.ai_inferred_invalid[] — the raw response plus the validation errors, quarantined

$comment: Validator lives in _lib/dual-contract.mjs (this schema's sibling implementation). The skill-lint rule `checkSkillDualContract({ label, body })` needs wiring into scripts/validate-skills.mjs at merge time.
